classification_policy: Fail-closed. VERIFIED_LOCAL only for claims fully checkable against on-disk files (in practice: claims about RP-1's own study checked against the cycle-5 tex snapshot). Every claim about external literature content is NEEDS_NETWORK_VERIFICATION at best, because no external paper text exists on local disk; Tori's recorded abstract-level checks are treated as supporting notes, not as local verification. REJECTED marks claims retracted in the corrected report, contradicted by on-disk ground truth, or prohibited by the wording contract (HWAO_GEMINI_WEB_VERDICT_20260711T000400Z: no 'establishes' or equivalent causal/settled verbs; non-commensurable absolute quantities must be labeled).
quoting_note: exact_claim fields quote the rejected report verbatim, including wording that violates the wording contract (e.g. the section heading 'What the literature appears to establish'). Those verbs belong to the quoted, rejected material and are reproduced solely for identification; the ledger's own prose does not use them.
line_reference_note: File:line references use the hash-pinned copies in sources-snapshot/ within this packet directory. RAW = GEMINI_WEB_OUTPUT.md, CORR = GEMINI_WEB_OUTPUT_CORRECTED.md, TEX = rp1_flagship_polished.tex, TORI = JOURNAL_CYCLE7_GEMINI_WEB_20260710T232711Z_TORI_PRELIMINARY.md, INTEG = JOURNAL_CYCLE7_GEMINI_WEB_20260710T232711Z_INTEGRATION.md.
